notes:
**Fix: in-app updater on Windows (Program Files / silent install)**

- Quote `/DIR="…"` when the install path contains spaces (e.g. `C:\Program Files\AssetValidator`)
- Pass Inno Setup flags as a single argument string (`/VERYSILENT`, `/FORCECLOSEAPPLICATIONS`)
- `Unblock-File` on downloaded installer (Mark-of-the-Web from browser download)
- Log Inno Setup output to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AssetValidator\update-inno.log`
- Use full path to `powershell.exe`; wait longer before exit so files unlock
- Sho
